description: Starts search preparation for one exact sealed table_version_id and optional search_revision_id. It may use embedding providers and workspace resources; the browser asks the person to approve it. Returns job_id and status. Queued/running is not ready and successful preparation is not activation. Next: get_search_job until terminal, inspect_table_search for readiness, then activate_table_search for the qualified generation on the person's request. If the outcome is unknown, inspect metadata before retrying.
name: build_table_search
title: Build a table search generation
